sources.researchNote: The BN descriptor records the variant forms Halicz, M.; Halicz, Marcela; and Halicz, Marcelina. It cites “Manuela / Marceli Halicz”, 1935, and Lerski 2003, and expressly records the Polski Słownik Biograficzny as a source in which no information was found, so no dates are established; her recorded responsibility is translation. VIAF heads her as “Halicz, Marcella, 19/20” — nineteenth to twentieth century, unspecified — and lists her Polish film songs, including “Ninon” and “Ninon, ach uśmiechnij się”, with numbers from the Kiepura films Kocham wszystkie kobiety and Dla Ciebie śpiewam. Wikidata Q95678216 additionally merges this identity with GND 1061346501, a Marcella Halicz recorded as a screen actress active in 1919–1924 and linked to filmportal. That merge is not adopted: nothing in the Polish authority evidence supports it, and the VIAF cluster carries no German material.
